app.name: Kids Incentives

onboarding.rewardsHint: Never family time, meals, affection or basic needs.
onboarding.goalHint: Something to save for; the app shows 25/50/75% milestones.
onboarding.celebrationHint: Brief and skippable. The child can change this later.

categoryHint.selfcare: Teeth, bed, tidy own room: acknowledgment by default; temporary points only while learning.
categoryHint.contribution: Set table, feed pet: 'we're a team'. Temporary points while learning, then fading.
categoryHint.routine: Homework routine, practice: tokens only, effort-based, never money per grade.
categoryHint.learning: Reading, instrument, exercise: reward the process, fade as habits form.
categoryHint.extra_job: Wash the car, weed the garden: beyond baseline. Money ledger arrives in V2; points for now.
categoryHint.repair: Part of a repair plan — never rewarded.

proof.needsLookExplain: Nothing is wrong — a parent just wants to take a look.

verificationHint.ai_assist: AI attaches a recommendation and reason; you confirm with one tap.
verificationHint.auto: Only after a successful manual history for a low-stakes task; audited ~10%, child can appeal.

help.title: I need something
help.explain: Choosing one of these is never a failure. A parent gets a note to teach, simplify, reschedule or adapt.

route.need_help: Teach: show an example or do it together once.
route.too_hard: Simplify: fewer steps or a smaller version.

appeal.childDefault: I don't think this is fair.

store.neverStore: Never in the store: family time, affection, meals, sleep, privacy, education, health, belonging.

goal.none: No goal yet. Ask a parent or propose one.
goal.focusHint: One primary goal and one optional secondary goal per child.

coop.title: Co-op adventure
coop.explain: A shared family goal with private contributions, flexible targets, no blame, and nothing ordinary gated behind it.
coop.targetHint: Number of co-op-tagged task completions across all children.
coop.celebrationHint: An optional extra — never regular family time or food.

avatar.neverSad: {{n}} tasks approved. Your companion never gets sad or loses anything.

me.privateNote: Only you and your parents see this. No ranks, no comparisons.

momentum.title: Momentum
momentum.childExplain: Momentum describes your current rhythm, not who you are. It only ever adds a small weekly bonus — it never takes anything away.
momentum.pausedChild: Bonus paused while we sort something out together.
momentum.parentExplain: Consistency Boost: a positive-only weekly bonus on eligible routine points (§1.9). Defaults are recommendations; a Supervisor may change them prospectively.
momentum.name: Name
momentum.capHint: Bonus never exceeds this share of eligible points.

warn.below_one: Level {{level}} has coefficient {{value}} (<1.00): this is a penalty tier and is not recommended.
warn.order: Level {{level}} requires a lower percentage than the level below it.

momentum.version: Configuration v{{v}} — changes apply prospectively and are explained to the child.
momentum.riskWarning: Coefficients below 1.00 or above 1.25 can turn levels into moral labels or a rich-get-richer system. Children never lose earned points either way.
momentum.confirmToggle: I understand the risk and want to publish
momentum.explainConfig: The momentum levels were changed by a parent. It applies from now on.
momentum.explainPromote: You reached a new momentum level!

praise.reflection: How did it feel to finish {{task}} today?

family.tempPassword: Temporary password — they should change it.
family.approvalLimitHint: Ordinary routines at or below this value.

family.superUserHint: Enter the recovery-owner password or an unused recovery code.

roleHint.nanny: Scoped role: assigned children, ordinary routines only.
roleHint.sponsor: Funds parent-approved rewards and sends kudos; cannot assign tasks or see proofs.

profile.title: Adjustable profile
profile.hint: Age was only a starting preset. Adjust each dimension separately.

independence.title: Independence Mode
independence.hint: Recover after lapses without losing progress; fade the app out as routines stick.

settings.title: Settings
settings.activeCapHint: Max habits earning frequent points at once (recommended 3).
settings.autoHistoryHint: A task must pass this many human reviews before AI auto-approval is offered.
settings.responseCostHint: Off by default. May only pause a small, pre-agreed privilege related to the rule, for up to 48h. Never points, goals, purchased rewards or basic needs.
settings.privacyNote: No bathroom/bedroom/eating proof templates. Only a hash and the AI note are kept after deletion.
settings.presetChanged: A parent changed the control preset.

presetHint.simple: Two habits, one reminder, AI off.

protect.basicNeeds: Basic needs, affection, meals, sleep, education and health are never conditional.
protect.privacy: Privacy by default; sensitive proofs are never requested.
protect.historicalEarnings: Points already earned are never removed.
protect.noShame: No shame copy, red zones, sibling comparison or failure sounds.
protect.noAiConsequences: AI and caregivers never issue consequences.

repair.title: Repair
repair.explain: Pause → Understand → Repair → Support → Close. The goal is learning and restoring — never lowering a child's standing.
repair.coaching: This week is correction-heavy. Consider simplifying expectations and reconnecting.
repair.parentOnly: Only parents can start this — never nannies or the AI.
repair.safetyRule: Critical safety rule (pauses the momentum bonus for review)
repair.planHint: Something that fixes or restores — related to what happened.
repair.supportHint: What we will change so it goes better next time.

explain.understand: We're figuring out what got in the way.
explain.repair: We agreed on a way to make it right.
explain.support: We're changing something so next time is easier.
explain.closed: This is closed. Nothing you earned was touched.

agreement.title: Family agreement
agreement.explain: Plain language, real choices, age-appropriate assent — reviewed every 4–6 weeks.
agreement.rulesHint: Concrete and few. Optionally name the related privilege for a response cost.
agreement.assentNote: Assent is voluntary; a child can request a change instead.
agreement.defaultIntro: We are a team. We help each other, we say what we need, and mistakes are for learning.
agreement.defaultRule1: Things go back to their place after we use them.
agreement.defaultRule2: Clothes go in the basket, not on the floor.
agreement.defaultRule3: We tidy our rooms at the agreed times.

suggest.simplify: Simplify expectations and reconnect: fewer tasks, more teaching.
suggest.teach: Show an example or do the task together once.
suggest.batch: Approve in one daily batch to cut delay.
suggest.reduceProof: Trust is growing — reduce proof to self-check for a task.
suggest.graduate: A habit looks stable — consider moving it to Independent or Graduated.

balance.independentDown: Independent starts went down vs. last week.
balance.tooManyTasks: {{n}} point-earning tasks active — more than recommended.

audit.title: Change history
audit.explain: Append-only log of approvals, points, settings, logins and roles.

starter.title: Starter Mode
starter.explain: Seven days, three tasks, two rewards, one goal — and a guaranteed practice success.
starter.completed: Starter Mode complete. Keep it small.

tip.1: Day 1: do one task together and approve it right away — the guaranteed success.
tip.2: Day 2: let the child open Today alone; stay nearby.
tip.3: Day 3: use the Praise Coach once with a specific observation.
tip.4: Day 4: notice reminders — can one be dropped?
tip.5: Day 5: check the store together; is the first reward reachable?
tip.6: Day 6: ask 'Easy / Okay / Hard?' about one task.
tip.7: Day 7: review the agreement and decide what to keep.

starter.installHint: Open this site in the browser on each tablet or phone and choose 'Add to Home Screen'. It works offline.

tip.0: Praise the strategy, not the trait: 'You remembered all three steps' beats 'You're so smart'.
tip.1: Three active habits is plenty. Everything else: acknowledgment.
tip.2: A missed day is information, not a failure. Ask what got in the way.
tip.3: Fade points as a habit stabilises — the goal is graduation, not permanent payment.
tip.4: Never pay for kindness, honesty or eating. Track, don't reward, what they already love.
tip.5: Consequences repair; they don't lower status. Cool off first.
tip.6: If you stop responding, the system loses meaning. Two minutes a day is enough.

loop.title: The core loop
loop.body: Understand → teach → support → reinforce → graduate. Points are a temporary scaffold. Before adding points, check the task is understood, feasible, practiced and supported.

points.title: Points vs. money vs. nothing
points.body:
Baseline self-care and contributions: acknowledgment, temporary points while learning.
Routines and school effort: points only, never money per grade.
Extra jobs: money-eligible (ledger in V2).
Kindness, honesty, eating: never systematically rewarded.
Activities they already love: track, don't reward.

praise.title: Feedback that helps
praise.body: Specific observation, strategy recognition, reflection question. Sincere, informational, autonomy-supportive. Neutral acknowledgment is fine too.

consequences.title: Consequences
consequences.body: Pause → Understand → Repair → Support → Close. Point loss is off by default. Never AI- or nanny-issued. No shame, no public zones, no sibling comparison, no loss of earned progress.

progress.title: Progress & siblings
progress.body: Private progress, consistency windows ('5 of 7'), no leaderboards or rank order. Co-op goals with private contributions and no collective punishment.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Visible capture, no sensitive-room templates, raw proofs deleted after review, no ads, no data sales. Children see who approved or changed something.

seekHelp.title: When to seek professional help
seekHelp.body: Persistent intense conflict, sudden behaviour changes, sleep or eating problems, self-harm talk, or distress that doesn't ease with simpler expectations: talk to a pediatrician or mental-health professional. This app is not a substitute.
